title: About Nathanael Harbison
paragraphs: Nathanael Harbison is a California-licensed real estate professional (DRE #02059393) serving buyers, sellers, and investors across Kern County. First licensed in 2018, he focuses on clear communication and practical advice to help you understand your options.

Whether you are buying your first home, relocating from Los Angeles, planning a sale, or considering an investment, he starts by listening. Your goals, budget, and timing shape the conversation and the plan that follows.

His perspective brings together real estate, development, and a long-term view of value. That means looking beyond the asking price to the property's condition, the work involved, and how it fits your plans.

Buying or selling a property is a significant decision. Nathanael's approach is to explain the trade-offs, discuss practical next steps, and give you room to decide without pressure. That respect for your time and goals is at the heart of Harbison Standard.
